subject.title: fix(config): improve validation error messages with line numbers, bracket paths, and received values

question: Which config representation may terminal validation use for `got:` hints, and what confidentiality contract must cover plugin-owned values?
rationale: The PR creates a new value-disclosure surface, while current snapshots distinguish authored, parsed, included, and resolved representations; choosing the permitted source and redaction boundary requires config-owner intent.

options.title: Effective values with redaction
options.body: Display only the value from the effective validation input, suppressing sensitive paths, SecretRefs, and plugin-owned fields without explicit safe metadata.

options.title: Authored values only
options.body: Display source-file values only when the issue is proven to originate from that file and the same redaction contract declares the field safe.

options.title: Omit received values
options.body: Land line numbers and bracket paths but defer `got:` hints until a broader confidentiality contract exists.

recommendation.title: Effective values with redaction
recommendation.body: Display only the value from the effective validation input, suppressing sensitive paths, SecretRefs, and plugin-owned fields without explicit safe metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available adjacent owner for deciding a repository-wide config disclosure contract, although file-level ownership provenance is incomplete.
